s: Dine hadas ubo y"d seipim: "vaanap etz abot", dareshu chakamim sheanapayv (perush alayv) chopin et etzayv, shekken hu mashmaut hakkatub "vaanap etz", kelomar shekkol haetz hu anap, dehaynu shehu mechuppeh bealin, al yede shehen (asuyin biqlia) shokebin al appehen, "abot" — shealayv qeluin kemin qelia, dehaynu shehen murkabin zeh al zeh keen shalshelet, veezeh hu? Heve omer zeh hadas:

Veeno niqra "abot" ella im ken yotzein mimmennu lepachot shelosha alin miqqen echad, kelomar sheyyotzein shelosha alin o yoter semukin zeh lazeh beiggul echad, sheen echad mehem namuk mechabero, ap al pi sheen kol hashshelosha alin yotzein meoqetz echad, kevan shehen debuqin zeh bazeh veomedin beshaveh beiggul echad — hare zeh "abot". Abal im shene alin hen omedin beshaveh debuqim zeh bazeh vealeh hashshelishi hu lemala mehem, o shehashshelishi yotze lematta mehashshenayim veoleh verokeb al gabbe hashshenayim — en zeh "abot", ella niqra "hadas shoteh", upasul kol shiba, apillu bishat haddechaq shei epshar limtzo hadas acher, veen littol oto apillu belo beraka, kevan sheeno min hadas hakkasher kelal. Ayyen siman trm"t:

Ulekattechilla mitzva lechazzer achar hadas shekkullo "abot", dehaynu shekkol haqqinnim shel alin hayyotzein bekol orek shiuro, shehu shelosha tepachim kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tr"n, yesh bekol qen vaqen shelosha alin. Umikkol maqom, im en kullo abot, kevan sherubbo abot, dehaynu sherob qinnim shel alin hayyotzein betok orek shiuro shehu shelosha tepachim yesh bekol echad veechad mehem shelosha alin — hare zeh kasher, umuttar lebarek alayv lekattechilla:

Veim battechilla haya kullo o rubbo "abot" veachar kak nasheru mimmennu alin, apillu nashar aleh echad mikkol qen vaqen mikkol haqqinnim shel alin hayyotzein bekol orek shiuro, vaapillu miqqetzat haqqinnim nasheru alehen legamre velo nishtayyer bahen apillu aleh echad, hoil uberob haqqinnim nishtayyer bekol echad veechad mehen rob shiur "abot", dehaynu shebbekol echad veechad mehen nishtayyer shene alin shelemin shello nasheru — hare zeh kasher:

Hadas hammitzri, sheyyesh bekol qen vaqen hayyotze mimmennu shiba alin venasheru mehen arbaa alin mikkol qen vaqen — hare zeh kasher, ap al pi sherob alayv nasheru, mikkol maqom hare nishtayyer shiur "abot" bekol qen vaqen. Abal im berob haqqinnim shel alin hayyotzein mimmennu nasheru chamishsha alin mikkol echad veechad mehen, apillu im miut haqqinnim lo nashar mehen kelal vehen shelemim shiba alin bekol echad veechad mehen, mikkol maqom kevan sherob haqqinnim nasheru rob alehen, vegam lo nishtayyer bekol echad veechad mehen shiur "abot" dehaynu shelosha alin — hare zeh pasul:

Ubimdinot ellu sheen hadassim kesherim metzuyin — nohagin lebarek al hadas sheen bo shelosha alin beqaneh echad ella hen gedelim shenayim al gabbe shenayim. Veyesh shellimmedu alehem zekut, shello ameru shekkol hadas sheen bo shelosha alin beqen echad hare zeh "hadas shoteh" ella kesheala hashshelishi:

Vahadassim haellu kevan sheen bahen raq shene alim bekol qen, lepikak im berob haqqinnim shel alin hayyotzein beorek shiuro shehu shelosha tepachim nashar aleh echad mikkol echad veechad mehen — hare zeh pasul, shehare berob haqqinnim lo nishtayyer bekol qen vaqen rob shiure "abot", dehaynu shene alin. Vetzarik lizzaher meod bazeh, deharbeh peamim nosherim alin harbeh mehahadas veen mashgichin al zeh:

Yabeshu alayv — pasul, lepi sheen zeh hiddur. Abal im lo higgiu liklal haybeshut ap al pi shekkebar kameshu — kasher. Vekamma shiur haybeshut? Keshehen niprakin batztzipporen keshemmemashmesh bahen vegam kala kol mareh yarqut shebbahen vehilbinu penehem — az hen niqraim yebeshim, shehare apillu im tashreh otan bemayim kamma yamim — lo yachzeru lemarehen, vahare hen keetz yabesh sheapillu im tashreh oto bemayim kamma yamim lo yasur mealayv shem hayyabesh. Abal qodem shehilbinu penehem, ap al pi shehen niprakin batztzipporen mechamat yebeshutan, mikkol maqom im tashreh otan bemayim yom o yomayim — yachzeru likmot shehayu bemishmushan ubemaritan:

Im yabeshu rob alin shel kol shelosha badde hadas venishtayyeru bekol bad ubad qen echad sheyyesh bo shelosha alin lachin — kasher. Vehu sheqqen hallach hazzeh hu omed berosh habbad, lepi sherosh habbad hu iqqar marit hahadas shehaadam roeh oto bitchillat hashqapato, veim hu yabesh — hare en hahadas hadar kelal, sheiqqar hadaro taluy berosho:

Veim hashshelosha alin ellu shebberosh habbaddim enan lachim gemurim ella hen kemushim, ap al pi sheim hayu kol ale hadas kemushim hare hu kasher, mikkol maqom akshav shekkullan yebeshim — en hakkamush matztzil miyyad hayyabesh shello yippasel, ella hallach hehadar hu shemmatztzil. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim, kevan shekkamush kasher — hare hu kelach lekol dabar, umatztzil miyyad hayyabesh shello yippasel. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem miyyom sheni shel chag vaelak sheen chiyyub netilat lulab bahen ella middibre soperim:

Ap al pi shekkol hamminim shel lulab shenniqtemu rashehen pesulin lepi sheen zeh hiddur, abal hadas shenniqtam rosho, apillu niqtam gup haetz shel hadas im alayv — hare zeh kasher, lepi shehahadas kevan shehu merubbeh bealin — hare alayv hannisharin chopin et meqom haqqetima veen haqqetima nikkeret. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim, deap hadas shenniqtam rosho, dehaynu shenniqtam rosh haetz atzmo shehealin yotzein mimmennu, kevan sherosho eno mehuddar — hare zeh pasul. Ulepi dibrehem apillu im lo niqtam rosho ella shehashshelosha alin shebberosho hen yebeshim, ap al pi sheshshear kol alin hen lachin umehuddarin, mikkol maqom kevan shehealin shebberosho enan mehuddarin — hare zeh pasul. Veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem bemaqom sheepshar limtzo hadas acher, abal im i epshar limtzo acher — muttar lebarek alayv velismok al sebara harishona:

Derek etz hahadas legaddel peri haddomeh laanabim, veim yesh beorek shiur hahadas shehu shelosha tepachim kol kak anabim hallalu yoter mimminyan healin haggedelin beorek zeh — hare zeh pasul apillu miyyom sheni vaelak, lepi sheanabim hallalu derek marehen lihyot shachor o adom vehahadas marehu yaroq — vahare zeh kimnummar veen zeh hiddur. Lepikak, im haya mareh haanabim hallalu yaroq kemareh hahadas — kasher apillu beyom rishon, ap al pi shehen merubbin mealayv:

Vaapillu im hayu adummot o shechorot vehayu merubbot al healin umiet otam, dehaynu shelliqqet vehesir miqtzatan mehahadas ad shehayu healin merubbin al haanabin, ben shemmiatan meereb yom tob ben sheabar umiatan beyom tob — hare zeh kasher, umuttar lebarek alayv lekattechilla. Abal lekattechilla asur lemaatan beyom tob, ap al pi shemmuttar litlosh perot beshabbat meanap hattalush mehailan meereb shabbat kemo shennitbaer besiman shl"v, mikkol maqom kevan sheal yede telisha zo mitkashsher hahadas lemitzvato — hare zeh kimtaqqen keli beyom tob. Vaapillu im hu eno mitkavven kelal lehakshir et hahadas ella kavvanato leekol et haanabim, mikkol maqom hare al korcho mitkashsher hahadas venaaseh keli al yede telisha zo, vahare zeh keen pesiq resheh vela yamut shennitbaer besiman sh"k, ayyen sham:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehu tzarik lahadas hazzeh sheen lo hadas acher, abal im yesh lo hadas acher veeno tzarik kelal lahadas hazzeh — muttar lo litlosh haanabim kede leoklan beyom tob, veap al pi sheal yede zeh mitkashsher hahadas venaaseh keli, mikkol maqom kevan shehu beatzmo eno tzarik lahadas hazzeh kelal — hare lo tiqqen kelum:
